current.Problems__c:

3. Integration friction: Evaluate the new API-first QuickBooks integration against their workflow and use Rev.io’s API and webhooks.

previous.Business_Issue_Details__c: Grey Matter MSP is evaluating whether to replace Halo PSA because the platform was implemented without intentional workflow design and is not supporting how the business actually operates across MSP/help desk, physical security, and audio-visual project work. They need a PSA that connects procurement, project management, assets, field mobility, reporting, and billing so revenue is captured accurately and teams can work from one operational system.
previous.Business_Issues__c: Broken Relationship with a Rev.io Competitor
previous.Problems__c:
- Halo does not flow cleanly from purchase order/sales order into project execution, budgets, assets, and cost tracking.
- Field technicians lack a strong mobile workflow, causing notes and time to be entered in bulk later, which creates missed detail and inaccurate time capture.
- Help desk and project work live in separate operational “worlds,” with limited cross-visibility and no unified calendar view.
- Static billing misses dynamic changes like license count increases, overtime, and project time.
- Reporting is weak enough that they rely on CloudRadial for client-facing reporting and previously used BrightGauge internally.
- Procurement notifications and received-item workflows are not intuitive.
previous.Values__c:

If the lower three weeks were actually 40 working hours each and a new workflow eliminated 50% of that work, that would be 60 hours, or USD $3,000, for a comparable project. 
- Mark estimated he spent 2–3 months entering parts over three years and speculated Patrick spent a similar amount.

previous.Business_Issues__c: Broken Relationship with a Rev.io Competitor
previous.Problems__c:
-Paul is dissatisfied with ConnectWise and reported a challenging onboarding experience.
-Construction estimates and project plans require significant manual work. Paul described spending a week or more estimating and several additional days translating an estimate into a project plan.
-Similar-looking parts can be difficult to distinguish without product thumbnails throughout the workflow.
-Mirna is concerned about the technical complexity of migrating and cutting over to a new platform.
-The team needs to validate integrations, project scheduling and the movement of purchasing data into customer assets.
previous.Solutions__c:
-Unified PSA with ticketing, dispatch, purchasing, inventory, asset management, projects, reporting and mobile access.
-Multi-technician and multi-day service scheduling; Paul confirmed the service workflow addressed his question.
-Ticket-linked purchasing, serialized receiving, inventory reservations and customer asset tracking.
-Dedicated onboarding support, training resources and a migration approach using available source data and APIs.
-Revii AI and a knowledge base to assist with questions, documentation and reporting.
-Connectwise or Ninja Integration
